chunks: Say: 'My Lord casts the truth; He is the Knower of the unseen.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God 'casts the truth' in Surah Saba?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores God's active role in manifesting truth to the prophets, distinguishing divine revelation from human speculation. It reinforces the concept of 'Ilm al-Ghayb' (Knowledge of the Unseen) as an exclusive attribute of Allah, often linked to the Imams' derived knowledge. The phrasing 'yaqthif' (casts/throws) suggests a dynamic projection of truth into the hearts of the chosen.
